# Serena Antonietta – The First Descendant (Nexon) – full data

Page: https://serena.freyna.org/
Official library: https://tfd.nexon.com/en/library/descendants/101000027
Data status: 02.10.2026 (live patch 1.4.4)

All values on this page are max level: Descendant stats at Lv 40 (max), all modules at their max enhancement level (Transcendent modules Lv 10, most others Lv 10, some Lv 5/7/9 as noted), weapons at Lv 100 with 4 stars (Ultimate weapons: Unique Ability Level 4; Transcendent weapons: Lv 100, Quality 400), reactors and external components at Lv 100.

## Overview
A Ranged DPS who maximizes airtime using an exclusive maneuvering device and annihilates enemies with a barrage of bullets from the sky. She grants allies blessings of protection and inflicts fiery judgment upon her enemies.

## Facts
- Name in game: Serena
- Full name: Serena Antonietta (Update 1.2.10: "Added a new Descendant, Serena Antonietta."; library story: "the Military Chaplain, Serena Antonietta, the holy fire spewing "Sister of Light"")
- Voice actor (EN): Jane Jackson (NEXON library, "Descendant Voice Actor")
- Attribute: Fire (all skills)
- Arche types: Singular (Sacred Flame, Ascension), Dimension (Soar, Redemption), Passive: Divinity
- Release: Update 1.2.10 (https://tfd.nexon.com/en/news/2745184), 13.03.2025, Season 2 "Beyond the Void"
- Where to farm: Research. Update 1.2.10: blueprints, codes and materials from Sigma Sector Dropoff Operations. Serena Code requires Amorphous Material Pattern: Serena (Shape Stabilizer Form 2 / Advanced Shape Stabilizer Form 2 usable since 1.3.34).
- Ultimate version: none (as of 02.10.2026)
- Synchronization Value: 1.177 (from 0.496, Update 1.3.34, 15.07.2026)
- Exclusive equipment: Photon Emitting Battlesuit "Exorcister"
- Descendant ID: 101000027

## Base stats (Lv 40, max)
- Max HP: 1,402
- Max Shield: 413
- Max MP: 243
- DEF: 2,325
- Shield Recovery Out of Combat: 3.96
- Shield Recovery In Combat: 3.3

## Skills
Texts verbatim from the official library. Numbers: "official" = Nexon patch notes; otherwise community database Gameslantern (ranges shown exactly as listed; no single max value claimed).

### Divinity – Passive (Passive Skill, Fire)
- Serena gains an additional stat bonus when firing a firearm in midair.
- Air Attack Increase: 45% [community (Gameslantern)]
- Air Explosive Attack Increase: 45% [community (Gameslantern)]
- Air Accuracy Increase: 30% [community (Gameslantern)]
- Air Recoil Reduction Rate: -30% [community (Gameslantern)]
- Damage Reduction while Airborne: -15% [community (Gameslantern)]

### Sacred Flame – Skill 1 (Active Skill, Fire, Singular)
- Fires flames in the direction of the crosshairs to deal damage and inflict Repentance. On hitting an ally, grants Blessing.
- Repentance acts the same as Burn. Firearm attacks against enemies inflicted with Repentance have a chance to recover Rounds for the firearm in use.
- Additionally, when an enemy with Repentance is killed, inflicts Repentance on nearby enemies.
- Flames pierce terrain when used on the ground and explode when colliding with terrain when fired in midair.
- Cooldown: 6s [community (Gameslantern)]
- MP Cost: 18 [community (Gameslantern)]
- Projectile Damage: Skill Power × 118.9% ~ 142.9% [community (Gameslantern)]
- Explosion Damage: Skill Power × 118.9% ~ 142.9% [community (Gameslantern)]
- Explosion Damage Range: Radius 7m (max expandable range 150%) [community (Gameslantern)]
- Repentance – Duration: 10s [community (Gameslantern)]
- Repentance – Continuous Damage: Skill Power × 7.1% ~ 8.5% every 1s [community (Gameslantern)]
- Repentance – Fire Skill Resistance Reduction: -20% [community (Gameslantern)]
- Repentance – Round Recovery on Firearm Attack: 10% chance, recovers 3% Rounds [community (Gameslantern)]
- Repentance – Propagation on Death: Radius 7m (max expandable range 150%) [community (Gameslantern)]
- Blessing – Duration: 8s [community (Gameslantern)]
- Blessing – HP Recovery: Max HP × 6% per 1s [community (Gameslantern)]

### Ascension – Skill 2 (Active Skill, Fire, Singular)
- Greatly decreases gravity while this skill is active. Firearm attacks while in mid-air have additional effects depending on the Rounds in use. However, Jump and Grappling Hook charge times have been adjusted.
- Cooldown: 1.2s [community (Gameslantern)]
- MP Cost: 10 (continuous MP cost -9) [community (Gameslantern)]
- Gravity Decrease: -85% [community (Gameslantern)]
- Grappling Hook Charge Time Increase: 100% [community (Gameslantern)]
- General Rounds: Multi-Hit Chance +5000%, Multi-Hit Damage +50% (since Update 1.3.34 multiplied instead of added) [community value; calculation change official (1.3.34)]
- Impact Rounds: Attack Drop-off Distance +30%; Critical Hit recovers Max MP × 12% [community (Gameslantern)]
- Special Rounds: Surrounding AoE Damage = Firearm Damage × 150%, Radius 10m, up to 20 enemies excluding the target (max expandable range 150%) [community (Gameslantern)]
- High-Power Rounds: 50% chance: additional Fire damage Skill Power × 381.2% ~ 393.3% on enemies with Repentance [community (Gameslantern)]

### Soar – Skill 3 (Active Skill, Fire, Dimension)
- When used on the ground, Serena shoots into the air.
- When used in midair, Serena moves quickly in the direction of movement and Reloads the currently equipped weapon.
- Additionally, Serena's number of Jumps is reset and holding down the skill key increases the distance traveled.
- Maximum Stacks: 3 [community (Gameslantern)]
- Stack Cooldown: 6s [community (Gameslantern)]
- MP Cost: 10 [community (Gameslantern)]
- Surrounding AoE Damage on Ground: Skill Power × 672% ~ 715%, Radius 3m (max expandable range 200%) [community (Gameslantern)]
- … during Ascension: Skill Power × 980.2% ~ 1042.8%, Radius 5m (max expandable range 200%) [community (Gameslantern)]

### Redemption – Skill 4 (Active Skill, Fire, Dimension)
- When used on the ground, removes all debuffs on Serena and all allies within range, and grants Prayer of Redemption.
- When used in midair, grants Redemption's Judgment to self.
- Cooldown: 44s [community (Gameslantern)]
- MP Cost: 60 [community (Gameslantern)]
- Effect Range on Ground: Radius 30m (max expandable range 200%) [community (Gameslantern)]
- Prayer of Redemption: 5s, 5 stacks, -18% damage per stack; each hit removes 1 stack and recovers Max HP × 12% and Max MP × 12% [community (Gameslantern)]
- Redemption's Judgment – Duration: 13s [community (Gameslantern)]
- Redemption's Judgment – Additional Damage on Firearm Attack: Damage Multiplier Max HP × 0.08%, up to 312%, no cooldown [official (Update 1.3.34)]
- Redemption's Judgment – Additional AoE Damage on Firearm Attack: Damage Multiplier Max HP × 0.09%, up to 351%, Radius 8m, cooldown 0.1s [official (Update 1.3.34)]

## Serena-exclusive modules (max level)
### Archangel
- Transcendent | Socket Almandine | Slot Skill | Max level: Lv 10 | Capacity at max level: 6 (Lv 0: 16)
- Effect (max level): Fire Holy Fire in midair to inflict Repentance on enemies, and grant Holy Passion. / Consume Holy Passion to deliver a Sacred Strike to the ground and increase power in proportion to the Holy Passion consumed.
- Changes Sacred Flame into Holy Fire, Soar into Blazing Offensive and Redemption into Sacred Strike (Update 1.3.34 notes: "When using the Blazing Offensive, drops Holy Fire while moving. Consumes Holy Passion to deliver a Sacred Strike, increasing its damage and range in proportion to the Holy Passion consumed.").
- Patch 1.3.36 (30.07.2026): Sacred Strike changed to ground-targeted Aim and Fire; its Final Critical Hit Rate Increase raised from 20% to 100%; tooltip renamed "Critical Hit Rate Increase" → "Final Critical Hit Rate Increase".
- Update 1.4.0: fixed abnormal movement in the air when knocked back during Blazing Offensive in the Ascension state.
- Further damage percentages of Holy Fire / Blazing Offensive / Sacred Strike are not published in the official data and are therefore not listed.
### Battlefield Nun
- Transcendent | Socket Cerulean | Slot Skill | Max level: Lv 10 | Capacity at max level: 5 (Lv 0: 15)
- Effect (max level): Attacking the Weak Point of the same enemy in midair grants Consecration and firearm attacks are enhanced based on accumulated Consecration. / Consume Consecration to summon an Aurora, which launches additional attacks while enhanced.
- Update 1.3.34 notes: gains Consecration with each Midair Attack on the same target's Weak Point; enhances Firearm Stats with each Consecration stack; consumes Consecration to summon Aurora, whose duration increases in proportion to the Consecration consumed.
- Update 1.4.3: fixed an issue where Aurora damage was applied abnormally. Exact values are not published in the official data.
### Hymn
- Transcendent | Socket Rutile | Slot Skill | Max level: Lv 10 | Capacity at max level: 5 (Lv 0: 15)
- Effect (max level): When used on the ground, creates a zone that increases the Jump of allies. When used in midair, temporarily increases the Movement Speed of nearby allies and increases maximum movement distance.
- Update 1.2.10 notes: on the ground Serena soars high into the air and leaves a Hymn of Exaltation (Jump of allies in range increased); in midair she moves and grants Hymn of Vitality (Movement Speed of nearby allies increased). Reloads the equipped weapon and resets her Jumps.
### Divine Surge
- Transcendent | Socket Rutile | Slot Skill | Max level: Lv 10 | Capacity at max level: 3 (Lv 0: 13)
- Effect (max level): Flies forward, inflicting Knockback on enemies in the path and deals large amounts of damage on landing. / Additionally, creates a path of fire in her wake that deals continuous damage to enemies within range.
- Update 1.3.34 (official values): MP Cost 30 → 25, Collision Damage 1,198.6% → 9,372.8%, Landing Damage 5,743.4% → 24,788%, Purifying Blaze Damage 87.6% → 968%.
### Hope's Resolution
- Ancestors | Socket — | Slot Main | Max level: no levels | Capacity at max level: 16
- Effect (max level): random options (Ancestors module)
- Ancestors module: no enhancement levels; 2–4 random options (positive and negative) are rolled and can be readjusted. Roll values scale with Serena's Synchronization Value (Update 1.3.34: 0.496 → 1.177). Rolls shown in the builds below are the build authors' rolls, not fixed values.

## Weapons (Lv 100; Ultimate at Unique Ability Level 4 = 4 stars)

### Volcanic Heart – Scout Rifle, Transcendent, Impact Rounds
- Pulsating Ember: Increases Fire Skill Power Amplification Rate while holding a weapon. Fire Skill hits on an enemy inflict Pulsating Ember, and firearm hits on an enemy inflicted with Pulsating Ember deal Additional Damage to the target. When defeating an enemy with a Fire Skill or firearm, there is a chance to grant Magma to self that deals Fire Damage to nearby enemies. Additional Damage dealt by this Transcendent Effect does not affect other skill effects.
- Lv 100: Firearm ATK 24,974 / Fire ATK 54,943 / Fire Rate 166 / Rounds per Magazine 30 / Reload Time 2.7 / Weak Point Damage 1.85 / Firearm Critical Hit Rate 50 / Firearm Critical Hit Damage 1.55 / Multi-Hit Damage 0.065
- Weapon modules in cited build (Cœur Volcanique / Volcanic Heart - Stat Stick by Khei_Khan, TFDHub): Rifling Reinforcement Lv 10: Firearm ATK +32%[x]; Better Insight Lv 10: Firearm Critical Hit Rate +35%[x]; Edging Shot Lv 9: Firearm Critical Hit Rate +29%[x] / Firearm ATK -15%[x]; Fire Enhancement Lv 10: Adds Fire ATK equal to 30%[x] of Firearm ATK; Defense Master Lv 10: When defeating an enemy, DEF +128.3%[x] for 10s (Cooldown 15s); Action and Reaction Lv 10: Firearm ATK +61%[x] / Recoil +20%[+]; Better Concentration Lv 10: Firearm Critical Hit Damage +43.8%[x]; Concentration Priority Lv 10: Firearm Critical Hit Damage +36%[x] / Reload Time Modifier -30%[+]; Fire Priority Lv 10: Fire ATK +50%[x] / Reload Time Modifier -30%[+]; Fire Rate UP Lv 7: Fire Rate -25%[x]

### ARMIS – Assault Rifle, Transcendent, General Rounds
- Autonomous Interception System: On hitting an enemy, launches an Interceptor Missile at the hit target to deal damage. Grants Countdown at max stacks and decreases stacks when firing a firearm. When Countdown is exhausted, the next shot launches a Small Warhead Rocket. On Multi-Hit, launches an additional Interceptor Missile and decreases Countdown. Inflicts Missile Fragment on enemies hit by Interceptor Missiles or Small Warhead Rockets. Attacking enemies with Missile Fragment using a firearm, causes shots to ricochet to nearby enemies, to deal Additional Damage.
- Lv 100: Firearm ATK 32,201 / Fire ATK 77,282 / Fire Rate 582 / Rounds per Magazine 30 / Reload Time 1.65 / Weak Point Damage 1.2 / Firearm Critical Hit Rate 2 / Firearm Critical Hit Damage 1.15 / Multi-Hit Damage 0.62
- Weapon modules in cited build (Armis Classic Multi-Hit, TFDHub): Rifling Reinforcement Lv 10: Firearm ATK +32%[x]; Fire Rate UP Lv 7: Fire Rate -25%[x]; Fire Enhancement Lv 10: Adds Fire ATK equal to 30%[x] of Firearm ATK; Charge Amplification Lv 10: Firearm ATK +67%[x] / Firearm Critical Hit Damage -40%[x]; Fire Priority Lv 10: Fire ATK +50%[x] / Reload Time Modifier -30%[+]; Multi-Percussion Sight Lv 9: Multi-Hit Chance +30%[+] / Firearm Critical Hit Damage -120%[x]; Multi-Piercing Sights Lv 10: Multi-Hit Damage +70%[x] / Firearm Critical Hit Damage -120%[x]; Action and Reaction Lv 10: Firearm ATK +61%[x] / Recoil +20%[+]; Multi-Bullet Lv 5: On landing multi-Hit, Multi-Hit Damage +5%[x] for 3s (Up to 3 stacks) and inflicts Deep Wounds on the target hit. / Deep Wounds deals damage equal to 3%[x] of Firearm DMG at regular intervals for 3s (Up to 3 stacks); Firing Fiesta Lv 10: When reloading, rounds are not consumed for 3s (Cooldown 15s)

### Emperor's Guard Lance – Beam Rifle, Transcendent, Special Rounds
- Emperor's Guard Lance: Aiming activates and cancelling aim deactivates Preview Mode. Firing while in Preview Mode deploys Emperor's Guard Lance. Deploying additional Emperor's Guard Lances after the Max Maintainable Emperor's Guard Lances has been reached, removes the first Emperor's Guard Lance deployed before deploying a new one. When hitting a certain number of times with a firearm, All deployed Emperor's Guard Lances trigger Emperor's Majesty that deals damage to targets within range. If a target within the attack range of Emperor's Guard Lance is hit by a certain number of Multi-Hits, triggers Emperor's Judgment and deals damage to the target.
- Lv 100: Firearm ATK 8,888 / Chill ATK 21,333 / Fire Rate 689 / Rounds per Magazine 50 / Reload Time 2 / Weak Point Damage 1.25 / Firearm Critical Hit Rate 3 / Firearm Critical Hit Damage 1.15 / Multi-Hit Damage 0.69

## Arche Tuning
- Node board with 5 Mutant Cell slots (174 nodes in the Open API; board layout not public).
- Mutant Cells used: Fire Chain Catalyst (Almandine), Defense Neutralization (Malachite) – Alcast.

## Story
The Generation of Despair refers to the first wartime generation, born on the brink of the Apocalypse and forced to grow up in a crumbling world. Trapped in a world that was collapsing around them, with evacuation and hunger as their only companions, the Generation of Despair grew up brighter than most people that were forced to live in such times. Since their lives began with war, there was never peace to be taken away from them.
Maybe that is why the Generation of Despair, contrary to its name, symbolizes the hope of the surviving members of humanity. When the Magisters joined humanity and conducted a census for the Arche Factor, this generation had the highest rate of Arche manifestation. Later records would reveal that out of the "Firsts," including the very first Descendant, Raley, nearly half were from the Generation of Despair. Included among them was the Military Chaplain, Serena Antonietta, the holy fire spewing "Sister of Light."
Serena was devoted enough to join the antiquated Order of Knights while hundreds of knights were dying daily at the hands of the Vulgus and the Colossi.
Serena's rise to prominence came when the Magisters, who had defected to humanity, awakened Arche in human DNA. Serena was also tested for Arche at this time and was determined to be a new kind of soldier, called a "Descendant." Among these "Descendants," she had the easiest time adapting to modern firepower, and was particularly adept at using it to develop her Arche abilities.
Serena's abilities manifested in the form of emitted Arche light particles. Serena's abilities became known as "Holy Fire" and were powerful enough to rival beam weapons, but could also be used to target Vulgus DNA. Using an extremely high concentration of radiation, she could burn out the Vulgus mutations. Applying these properties, Serena used her Arche to cure the Vulgus infection. Her light was a beacon of hope for her people and of dread for her enemies. Another unexpected benefit of her Arche was that she was able to spend time with her crush, fellow Descendant Raley, while healing him.
But the shy feelings faded as the Descendants were deployed to the frontlines. Serena's mission at the time was to investigate the epicenter of the Apocalypse in order to prove the Magisters' Dimension Isolation Theory. Serena promised her family of Knights, her comrades-in-arms, and her crush, Raley, that she would return soon... But, no one knew it would be the last time they'd see her. The epicenter of the Apocalypse was the most heavily polluted area, now called Sigma Sector, and it contained not only Void Contamination, but also a darker plot than anyone could have ever imagined. As the last light was extinguished, Serena faced despair for the first time. Death seemed so far away, but there also seemed to be no hope of waking again. There was only pitch-black darkness enveloping her body... as all her senses began to shut down.
Serena prayed with all her might, until her consciousness faded. If only I could wake once again, I would burn with a light that would never be extinguished. I will restore hope to all, I will be a ray of sunshine for Raley...
After the echoes of her wish reverberated for a century, Serena's prayers were finally answered. She opened her eyes once again, still in Sigma Sector, but, with unfamiliar Descendants standing over her, surprised. Serena realized instinctively, that The Age of Despair had not ended yet. As she promised herself in her hundred years of prayer, she joined the new generation with an unquenchable radiance.
This time, with a new prayer, to never again have to feel such despair...

## Exclusive Equipment, Photon Emitting Battlesuit Exorcister
The Magisters' warfare technology was at its peak before they lost most of their equipment to frequent retreats. The Photon Emitting Battlesuit Exorcister is one piece of such equipment. This powerful exoskeleton is the ultimate assault weapon, amplifying the Arche particles emitted outside the body, ionizing the user's Arche, and granting them the ability to maneuver in the air. Specifically, the Arche sorbent stabilizers can read micro-muscular signals to adjust the direction of movement, giving the user the movement of an angel from ancient Ingris mythology. The problem is, Serena is the only one who can wield it with any level of sophistication. So, it is practically Exclusive Equipment for her at this point. Not to mention, that the core technology was lost in its entirety and has yet to be fully restored even to this day.
"Uhh... so... it seems to operate... using electricity." - Serena Antonietta, explaining the battlesuit to Raley...
